name: Tries
tagline: Words that start the same share a path.
complexity: O(L) per insert or lookup (L = word length), O(total letters) space

blocks.html: A phone keyboard: type ca and it already offers car and cat. A trie is a tree of letters where words that start the same way share the same first nodes.

blocks.text: Example: count words with a prefix

blocks.note: Scan every word for every query, then walk a trie once per query

blocks.html: Store a count on each node as you insert. Then a prefix query costs only its own length, however many words you stored.

blocks.q: Cost of one prefix query of length L on a trie of N words?
blocks.why: You follow one child per letter. The number of words never enters.

pitfalls: Mark word ends separately: app is a prefix of apple and also a word.
Stop as soon as a letter is missing; return 0 or False instead of reading from None.
Nested dicts are enough in Python. You rarely need a Node class.
